patch_description: This version combines the fast batched population evaluation strategy with a smoother “tight triangle” merit function and deterministic coordinate polishing. Four square corners remain fixed, guaranteeing a convex unit-area hull and making the raw minimum triangle area equal to the normalized objective. The population phase uses both direct maximin selection and a small average-of-active-constraints bonus early in the search, which helps avoid local configurations dominated by one accidental small triangle. Final coordinate-direction refinement accepts only genuine improvements to the primary minimum-area objective.
